title: Notification regarding Preparation of a panel of translators for transiating the judgments of Supreme Court and High Court.
text:
KEY LINES:
In continuation to High Court notice dated 25.08.2023
earlier vide notice dated 25.08.2023.
Dated:-16.10.2023
Dated:16.10.2023

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF JAMMU & KASHMIR AND LADAKH
(Office of the Registrar General at Srinagar)
Subject:- Preparation of a panel of translators for transiating
the judgments of Supreme Court and High Court.
k*** *
In continuation to High Court notice dated 25.08.2023
regarding the subject captioned above, it is hereby notified for the
information of all the concerned that the consent, in the form of an
application, is hereby invited from the retired Judicial Officers and
retired Translators, who were under the employment of High Court
and the State/UTS of J&K and Ladakh and the Advocates as well, for
their empanelment on the Panel of the Translators for the High Court
of J&K and Ladakh, on the terms and conditions which were notified
earlier vide notice dated 25.08.2023.
Dated:-16.10.2023
The consent should reach the office of the undersigned,
with full particulars and supporting documents within 21 days from
the date of this notice.
By Order
No.468466RG/GS
NOTICE
Copy of above forwarded to the:
2. Secretary to Hon'ble Mr. Justice Atul Sreedharan,
1. Principal Secretary to Hon'ble the Chief Justice, High Court of J&K and Ladakh.
3. Secretary to Hon'ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Dhar,
....for kind information of their Lordships.
Sd/
(Shahzad Azeem)
Registrar General
Dated:16.10.2023
